name: agentic-sdlc
description: Planner → architect → coder(+navigator) → code-reviewer pipeline. /plan decomposes a brief into epics, stories and ARCH handoffs; /build cascades an epic onto one branch, building each story SOLO or as a navigator⇄coder TDD pair, and opens a PR. Handoffs, a tooling-debt ledger, ping-pong pairing and model tiering are part of the protocol. /review spawns the code-reviewer against an open PR, posting one round comment with stable findings that the coder's REVISE mode closes. --fast on either command takes the lean lane instead: a flat task list, decide-and-log instead of handoffs, only the tests that catch expensive bugs, and every shortcut in the ledger.
